text_markup: Some cards have the subtype {subtype:priority} and the text, "Play only as your first [click]." A player can only play a {subtype:priority} card using the basic action to play an event or operation, and only if they have not spent any other clicks that turn. Losing clicks does not affect a player's ability to play a {subtype:priority} card.
